info.title: ForecastIQ API
info.description: Weather forecast accuracy comparison platform. First vertical slice endpoints. All successful responses use the standard envelope (docs/api/02-response-conventions.md); errors use RFC 7807 (docs/api/03-error-and-partial-result-contracts.md).

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: reserved (MVP ignores; spatial filtering is post-MVP)

put.description: Updates mutable fields (name only). Coordinates, country_code, and timezone are immutable after creation (domain architecture §2.3).

patch.description: Soft status change (BR-LOC-03): disabling stops future collection; historical data remains queryable.

get.summary: Latest forecast for a provider + location
get.description: Raw forecast data (gated: authenticated user with the read:data API-key scope; AUTH-08).

post.summary: Replay a stored collection payload through the current adapter (admin)

get.description: Composite provider rankings for a location + horizon with per-component breakdown, CIs, statuses, ties, and the latest observation context. Public; cached (ETag + LRU 60s).
Published statistical methodology: formulas, default weights, thresholds, coverage penalty, statuses, tie rule, and change history. Static config; long-cached.

Location mode (location_id): providers' metric grid + ranking status + collection window. Provider mode (provider_id): all ranking cells. Exactly one of location_id or provider_id required. Public; cached.

Time-bucketed metric series for a location + horizon + variable + metric_type over a bounded period (<=365 days), bucketed to the requested timezone's local day/week/month boundaries (tz-aware date_trunc, post-scan). Every bucket carries sample_count (hollow points). Public; cached.
One provider with attribution + lineage (adapter_version, collecting_since) for the S-03 header (§4.1).

Bounded public payload for one location + day + variable: per-provider forecast lines at the DR-02-selected issuance, the day's observations (gaps absent), and in-memory day metrics. Public; cached (ETag).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: ISO date interpreted in the location timezone

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: CSV of provider UUIDs (default: all active)

get.description: Operational triage: per provider×location cell (last success, next scheduled, freshness), provider circuits, observation collector, and system section (payload volume, engine lag, backup/restore status). Served from application tables + statfs + backup status file. Admin only; no-store.

patch.summary: Enable or disable a provider (S-11, admin)

patch.description: Operator-mutable fields only; the credential reference is never accepted or returned.

get.description: Keyset-paginated audit trail (newest first), filterable by action, resource_type, user_id. Admin only.

post.description: Runs the analysis pipeline on demand (match → aggregate → rank). Audited.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile. Self-scope; no-store.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's mutable fields (default location, preferences). Self-scope; audited; no-store.

delete.description: Self-service account deletion. Local rows removed (keys cascade; audit anonymized), then the auth-provider delete propagates.

get.description: Lists the authenticated user's API keys (metadata only; never the secret). Self-scope; no-store.

post.description: Mints an API key. The plaintext key is returned exactly once (never re-derivable). Audited; no-store.

delete.description: Revokes a key the authenticated user owns (idempotent). Unknown or non-owned keys return 404 (no existence disclosure). Audited.

get.description: Keyset-paginated user list (newest first). Admin only; no-store.

patch.description: Sets a user's status (active|disabled). Refuses self-target (409 self-lockout). Bans/unbans in the auth provider first, then persists + audits. Admin only.

delete.description: Deletes a user account. Refuses self-target (409 self-lockout). Local rows removed (keys cascade; audit anonymized), then the auth-provider delete propagates. Admin only.

post.description: Ingests signed Supabase auth events into the audit trail (audit-requirements §5). Public route, gated by an HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw body in the X-Webhook-Signature header (timing-safe). Non-blocking: a valid signature yields 204 even if the audit write fails; an invalid/missing signature is 401. Mounted only when a webhook secret is configured.
Creates an account-data export (user row + API-key metadata + own audit events). One active job per user (409). Self; no-store.

post.summary: Request a user's GDPR export (S-14, admin; AUTH-09)
post.description: Admin-triggered account-data export for a target user. One active job per user (409). Admin only; no-store.

get.description: Streams the account-data JSON for a completed, unexpired export the caller may access (requester, target, or admin). Self/admin; no-store; 404 unknown/non-owned, 410 when the 24h window closed.
Returns the collection's lineage row plus all its stored snapshots — the historical raw-data view behind /forecasts/latest.
All configurations (active + disabled) with has_credential and the collection schedule. The credential reference is never echoed (BR-08).

override_reason.description: Operator justification for accepting a near-duplicate (BR-LOC-01 override; audited). Required when allow_near_duplicate is true.

status.description: Target status. Only active and disabled are settable; archived is reserved.
